dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: As long as you let your consciousness freely drift, it doesn't matter where you are.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...Though, according to normal standards, the environment here is quite pleasant indeed.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Pure, clear air, a soft, warm bed, a lot of open space...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Had we grown up in an environment like this, Lyney probably wouldn't have been nearly so anxious.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: ...I seem to have allowed some subjective thoughts to color my review. Please pay it no heed. Objectively speaking, this is a delightful place.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: It is well-suited to spacing out. My charging speed is currently 5% faster than usual.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: ...By my standards, that is the highest praise that can be given.
